topic: Day 136 — reel — The failure you're tempted to explain away is the one that teaches most
text:
The failure
you [explain] is
the one you
don't learn.
caption:
Justifying it immediately short-circuits the reflection that would have extracted the lesson. The best explanations come with the least growth.
